entities.name: Alt David
entities.description: An alternate version of David traumatized by the destruction of Earth Prime who leads the Covenant to alter minds and recreate his lost family.
entities.quote: made a dark org named covenant and he was covenant leader.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: David's brother from Earth Prime who wished to leave the hero life behind before dying during the collapse of their world.
entities.quote: in that universe zayn and david already knew they were brothers.

entities.name: Prime Nyxia
entities.description: A hero from Earth Prime who died attempting to prove that humanity had changed since Asetra's time.
entities.quote: prime nyxia died tried to prove that huminty is changed than asetras time

entities.name: Asetra
entities.description: An entity who appeared in Shina's body in Earth Prime, triggering events that destroyed that universe.
entities.quote: after asetra in shinas body appeared in their universe and things got messi

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A hero alive in the new world whose growth involves accepting pain, contrasting with Alt David's attempt to erase it.
entities.quote: When he arrives here and sees: Ethan alive.

entities.name: Dew
entities.description: A researcher conducting experiments with hero blood who is covertly assisted by Alt David.
entities.quote: he knew dew and stitch has different reason to use heroes blood and experiment.

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: An experimenter utilized by Alt David as a stepping stone to advance memory and mind alteration techniques.
entities.quote: He isn’t helping Stitch for ideology. He’s using him as a stepping stone.

entities.name: Covenant
entities.description: A secret dark organization led by Alt David to research mind alteration, hero blood, and memory rewriting.
entities.quote: made a dark org named covenant and he was covenant leader.

timeline_events.title: Alt David's Arrival
timeline_events.description: Following the loss of his brother and world, Alt David used his cube-enhanced portal to travel to the main world.
timeline_events.quote: david used his portal enhanced by cube and came to this world.
